title: asset_inventory
description: GENERATED by scripts/codegen.ts from contracts/ — do not edit. Run `npm run gen`.

event_id.description: Deterministic UUID (version 8, hash-derived) identifying the event. Used for deduplication.

event_ts.description: When the event happened, Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), ISO 8601 with millisecond precision and a Z suffix.

customer_id.description: Quandong customer code. MFW = Murray Flats Water (fictional).

site_id.description: Pump station (PS01 to PS40) or HO for head office.

feed.description: Name of the feed this event belongs to.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the contract the event was produced against.

generator_run_id.description: Identifier of the generator deployment (seed and configuration) that produced the event.

asset_id.description: Stable asset identifier, {site}-{type code}-{nn}, e.g. PS03-PLC-01.

vendor.description: Manufacturer (fictional). "Unknown" when the sensor cannot fingerprint the device.

firmware_version.description: Firmware version reported by the device, or null when unknown.

logic_checksum.description: Checksum (CRC-32, hex) of the control logic loaded on a programmable device; null for devices that do not hold logic.

ip_address.description: Private IPv4 address of the asset.

purdue_level.description: Level in the Purdue reference model (0 = process, 1 = basic control, 2 = supervisory, 3 = site operations, 4-5 = enterprise).

first_seen.description: When the sensor first observed the asset (UTC).

last_seen.description: When the sensor most recently observed the asset (UTC).
